verdict.rationale: The API documentation covers campaign name, subject, sender and recipient list. Design is only inherited by duplicating a campaign and then editing it in the Benchmark UI, so there is no documented API for managing template content. Pasting or uploading HTML in the UI with merge fields is an adjacent manual workflow. Keeping that HTML under version control would be a user-side workaround, not a templates-as-code capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control
